notes.title: Update 4.3
notes.content: [p]Now is the time for Ohio.  Now is the time to live a better life in Cleveland.[/p][p][/p][p]This update includes:[/p][p]New screen resolutions![/p][p]Updated NPC graphics![/p][p]More furniture added to some of the rooms!  Things are getting cozy![/p][p][/p][p]Also, check out 'The World Ends in Ohio' where the Cleveland adventure continues!  It releases soon![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 4.2
notes.content:
Do you want to explore the vast lands of Ohio this week?  Find the life in Cleveland you always wanted with this new update:

- Faster gameplay!  Wow!
- Updated graphics!  Sweet!

The best role-playing games are the ones that let you live in Ohio.

notes.title: Update 4.1
notes.content:
Do you yearn for adventure in Ohio?  Do you want to rent a sweet apartment in Lakewood, enjoy a trip to the mall in Strongsville, and fight off a mutant invasion in Cleveland?  Then check out this new update!

- New UI when talking to Clevelanders!
- Better graphics make you feel like you're relaxing at Lake Erie!
- More Ohio!

Find the life you're looking for in the Midwest!

notes.title: Update 4.0
notes.content:
Ohio is calling. It is your destiny. Meet your destiny and other strange individuals around the Midwest with this new update!

Better graphics!
Better sound!
Better gameplay!

Cleveland thanks you for playing.

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
You need to ask yourself the tough questions, such as 'Are you playing an RPG this week?' and 'Does that RPG take place in Ohio?'  If you answered yes to both those questions, then you made some good decisions in life.

Updates to the pixel art, Steam Achievements and a new game logo that's pretty flashy.  

Your destiny is in Ohio.  Don't let your destiny slip away.

notes.title: Update 3.1
notes.content: Now you can experience improved door animations and enjoy all the wonders Cleveland, Ohio has to offer.  Some bug fixes and graphics updates will also improve gameplay.  Everything you're searching for in life is in Ohio.  Play today and find the meaning of life somewhere in Cleveland.

notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.content: A bunch of updates to the graphics, input responsiveness and bug fixes.  All types of adventure awaits you in Ohio with the improved gameplay.  Make this summer one to remember by spending it across the Midwest, especially if you can do it while fighting back against a mutant invasion.
